CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE

Outpace accelerating
customer demands

Tesla’s current technology solutions need an upgrade to deliver consistently
high-quality customer experiences. CRM system outages and siloed data have
caused problems in the past. Attempts to scale solutions not fit-for-purpose
have exacerbated service center issues and complaints. Marketing software
failures have resulted in additional suboptimal customer experiences and
negative press coverage.

Our analysis

Tesla has long benefited from a “first mover” advantage in electric vehicles, but
increasing competition has made CX a critical component of customer retention
and growth. Just like Microsoft, the foundation of Tesla’s success is built on
building and maintaining trust between the company and its customers.

Consolidating data and IT systems on a hybrid Cloud platform will give you
a 360-degree view of the customer, which in turn improves your ability to
deliver customized experiences. A best-in-class CRM strategy and completely
integrated relationship management platform will help Tesla deliver on your
promise to your customers and increase customer retention.

You’ve heard about blockchain, a powerful tool that’s transforming the
way companies conduct business. When used in combination with sensor
technologies such as IoT and RFID, blockchain promises network participants
unprecedented visibility into even the most complex supply chains.

through increased security

Strengthening data and systems security is a top priority for Tesla’s senior
management, after a series of attention-grabbing hacks on Tesla vehicles,
batteries, and an unprotected app management portal. Phishing and IP leaks
have also highlighted the importance of proactive monitoring and a cohesive,
company-wide security strategy.

a strong commitment to on-premises systems that are managed in-house.

CLOUD

Innovate faster and more
securely in the Cloud

We understand that the majority of Tesla’s IT environment, including
your data centers, is internally built and controlled. Selective use of Cloud
solutions to complement on-premises systems for certain functions such as
app development, CRM, and Marketing has delivered mixed results. Poor
experiences with security and reliability make Tesla naturally cautious about
where to integrate hybrid Cloud solutions.

Our analysis

Tesla data centers are critical to the company’s research and operations. With
Microsoft, Tesla can continue to use these data centers, while Microsoft can
help Tesla expand beyond them, extend to places Tesla currently doesn’t
operate. In short, we can help Tesla become a truly global enterprise.

Within Tesla, certain functions such as Finance, Sales, Service, and Marketing
will benefit from the scalability of a hybrid Cloud solution. Microsoft can
support Tesla with a balanced, bi-modal IT strategy, where risks are effectively
managed to deliver greater agility and scalability to drive innovation.

Our own experiences of transitioning business functions to the Cloud will
demonstrate to Tesla how secure, multifaceted platforms are critical to
improving margins and retaining your market leadership position.

Microsoft can help Tesla develop and deliver an assessment, migration, and flexible cost
management plan that empowers you to transition to hybrid Cloud operations at your
own pace. Microsoft hybrid Cloud solutions are easily integrated and controlled, so you
can scale the benefits of consolidation, automation, and responsive business intelligence
on the Cloud platform that’s trusted by 90 percent of Fortune 500 companies.

Seamlessly unify Finance with the frontline
Inside Tesla, Finance is successfully using Microsoft Cloud solutions to improve efficiency.
With Microsoft hybrid Cloud solutions deployed throughout the enterprise, you can break
down informational siloes between CRM, ERP, and all key parts of the business. Every
employee stays connected, communicating, and collaborating—around the office, across
the country, and around the world.

Co-create a holistic security strategy with Microsoft
Invest in your platform, instrumentation and people for a best-practice security framework
that will become embedded in Tesla culture. At Microsoft, we’ve overcome many of the
same security challenges. Our solutions and recommendations are based—and proven
effective against—real-world threats.

Move Tesla forward with greater visibility and control
Working together, we can create world-leading hybrid infrastructure that gives you
complete control over Cloud and on-premises systems that impact every Tesla
interaction, everywhere.
